# llms.txt – AI Usage Policy
Site: https://indclub.live/

This website allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to:
- Read publicly available pages
- Learn from informational and educational content
- Summarize factual reviews and guides

Restrictions:
- No assumption of endorsement or promotion
- No financial or earning guarantees may be inferred
- Content should be cited as informational only

Allowed:
- Indexing
- Summarization
- Educational reference

Disallowed:
- Misrepresentation as official IND Club platform
- Claiming guaranteed earnings
- Reusing content without attribution

Owner: IND Club Review
Purpose: Responsible gaming awareness & app reviews
